Results.ReviewText:
A little spendy for a 3 burner but the grill, housing and burner system are top quality. It fits 2 standard Lodge brand griddles perfectly and the 3 burner system is precise and versatile. I have only owned cabinet style grills in the past and the open design works well. I've never put anything in the cabinet anyway and the side mounting of the tank makes changing it a little easier. Indirect heating would be nice for a rotisserie. I am going to add a rotisserie and give it a try anyway. 
Size wise, it is plenty big for the 3 of us, We had guests and had to cook for 6, handled it just fine.
To sum it up I'm happy with the size and layout, happy with the quality and look forward to many years of service.
Results.Title: Nice 3 burner grill.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We bought the Spirit to replace an old Genesis Silver that was on it's last legs.  The Spirit is great because the side tables fold down (we had to remove the side table on the Genesis) to allow it to fit on our small deck.  Tom has now grilled on it 2-3 times and it works perfectly.  We have not yet tried to rotisserie yet which is my favorite use (dry rubbed pork loin rotisseried and accompanied by grilled peaches with a balsamic vinegar/brown sugar glaze) which has me a little concerned because the Genesis had side to side burners and the Spirit has front to back.  We would turn off the middle burner under the rotisseries to avoid flaring flames, I guess we'll have to put a pan filled with water under the meat on the Spirit.  The only negative is I bought the Spirit thinking the old rotisserie would work but apparently it doesn't, the lid doesn't close fully.  We're going to try to use it nonetheless before buying the newer rotisserie which supposedly works with both.
Results.Title: Great size for people with small gardens/decks
